type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_preserves_semantics
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (e : Expr) (h : e.isClassical = true) (σ : State) : isBlocked σ e = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_stability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : e.isClassical = true) : (stateGuidedRewrite σ e).isClassical = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_completeness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : resolutionSet σ e = [v]) : collapseOp σ e = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_correctness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (c : ClassicalConst) (h : collapseOp σ e = some c) : collapseTrigger σ (.constrained e .collapse) = .term (.cst c)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_soundness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : collapseOp σ e = some v) : v ∈ resolutionSet σ e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.local_completeness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : UniqueSolution σ e) : ∃ v : ClassicalConst, Collapse e σ = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.local_completeness_exact
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : resolutionSet σ e = [v]) : Collapse e σ = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.no_spurious_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Formula) (h : ∀ σ : State, σ.equations = [] → σ.constraints = [] → satisfies σ φ) : universallyValid φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.operator_conservativity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (op : ClassicalOp) (t₁ t₂ : Term) (h₁ : t₁.isClassical = true) (h₂ : t₂.isClassical = true) : (Term.app (.classical op) t₁ t₂).isClassical = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.restricted_confluence
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) : ∀ e : Expr, e.isClassical = true → MultiStepRewrite σ e e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.uniqueness_implies_recovery
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : hasUniqueResolution σ e = true) : ∃ v : ClassicalConst, collapseOp σ e = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.wellformedness_preservation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e e' : Expr) (h : MultiStepRewrite σ e e') : e'.depth ≤ e.depth + 1
